svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Strike ladder coverage of the 717 basis pairs
svg.text: Each solid rung is one emitted pair. Blue = Kalshi floor, orange = Polymarket floor, exactly one cent apart.
Dashed = a rung the venue ladder implies for which this capture emitted no pair. Hover one for its measured counterpart distance.
21 listed closes on 2 assets is the whole emitted book for this capture window. Rung spacing is the venues own ladder spacing, not a sample.

39 dashed rungs. 39 have a same-strike counterpart elsewhere in the capture, at measured listed-close deltas of 0h, 1h, 4h, 5h, 6h, 7h, 8h, 10h, 11h, 12h, 13h, 14h, 16h, 17h, 18h, 19h, which the hard measurement-instant gate refuses to pair and which sit in related-pairs.jsonl.
